meta.name: Militainment Inc.
meta.description: Militainment Inc.examines how news coverage of war in the United States has come to resemble Hollywood film, video games, and reality television in its portrayal of war as entertainment. Using a range of media examples–from news anchors’ idolatry of military machinery to the impact of government propaganda on war reporting–Militainment Inc.asks: How has war taken its place as a spectacle of entertainment? And how does presenting war as entertainment affect the ability of the population to evaluate the real human costs of this culture’s military-industrial-complex?
